restricted_pattern_observations: Account generation, query-limit bypass, cookie/session extraction, browser/TLS impersonation, anonymous proxying or other service-access circumvention patterns observed in unofficial lineage are not admitted for CFA3 reuse by this intake.
Only transport, schema, streaming, retry, error-normalization, MCP, RAG, ranking and UI architecture patterns may proceed to later independent review.

requirements: Reference registration only; no code import, runtime dependency, provider/model admission or activation.
The Perplexity organization and GitHub topic pages are discovery/reference indexes and do not recursively admit child repositories, packages, services or models.
Official Perplexity API/MCP material may inform protocol and research patterns, but CFA3 architectural authority remains unchanged and upstream contracts must be reverified at material-use time.

Unofficial repositories are non-authoritative references; account generation, query-limit bypass, cookie/session extraction, impersonation, anonymous proxy or access-circumvention behavior is excluded from admissible CFA3 reuse by this intake.
Community repositories require independent License & Rights, provenance, Security, Software Coexistence and supply-chain review before any material reuse.
The fixed CFA3 capability baseline remains 175 and no architectural authority is added.
FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001 remains the sole provider/model routing authority; FA3-LLM-GATEWAY-001 remains the LLM data plane; no silent local-to-cloud fallback is introduced.
Actual adoption requires an explicit usage edge plus all applicable fail-closed gates.
